title: Rabbi Bana’ah the Early
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Berakhot 55b: “Rabbi Bizna said that Rabbi Akiva said that Rabbi Panda said that Rabbi Nachum said that Rabbi Birim said in the name of an elder — and who is he? Rabbi Bana’ah: There were twenty-four dream interpreters in Jerusalem. Once I dreamed a dream and went to all of them,” etc. Hyman considers this Rabbi Bana’ah undoubtedly early, when Israel was still in Jerusalem. Hyman reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads: “Rabbi Parna said in the name of an elder — and who is he? Rabbi Nehorai.” Hyman considers the word Nehora’ah very easily confused with the name Bana’ah.

notes.text: Undoubtedly retains Hyman’s asserted strength, while the proposed early dating and Nehorai/Bana’ah letter confusion remain attributed to him.
